reviews.title: We don’t have teleportation devices
reviews.text:
It appears to have many good options, though it lacks in fundamental quality of life features. 

First-
When I downloaded the app, without starting or subscribing, it started automatically recording the days as missed training. 

Second-
The moment t I bought a subscription, aside from being “behind in schedule” I was presented with more purchases to make the moment I opened the app. This is still ongoing. 

Third- 
By far the most annoying aspect. It gives me four seconds to move from one position to another and have the weights ready. What in the actual heck?!
Standing crouches with weights and then lay down for overhead pushes in four seconds?

Do the developers even check the code their AI is pushing out? Because I’ve been to gyms in my life and the devs clearly show they’ve never stepped outside a city that has a gym.
